title: assets/ templates are unreachable — zero references from SKILL.md or any reference file
reality: The skill ships four starter templates (assets/character-card.template.json, custom-agent.template.json, custom-tool-webhook.template.md, lorebook-entry.template.json) and README.md advertises them as included materials. grep for 'assets/' returns 0 matches in SKILL.md and 0 across every file in references/. Nothing instructs Claude to read or offer them, so in practice they are dead weight.
fix: Add an 'Starter templates' row or block to SKILL.md — ideally in the 'When to consult bundled references' table or at ideation step 5 (Offer the next step), where the skill already offers to produce a character card / tool definition. HIGH severity relative to effort: the assets exist and are good, but the skill cannot currently use them.

title: custom-agent.template.json is behaviorally stale under v2.4.0
reality: assets/custom-agent.template.json ships "settings": {} with no contextSources key, and its promptTemplate tells the agent 'You will receive: The latest assistant message, Recent context'. Under v2.4.0 (#4305) a custom agent with no stored contextSources falls back to DEFAULT_CUSTOM_AGENT_CONTEXT_SOURCES — chatHistory only. An agent built from this template therefore silently receives no character card, persona, lorebook, summary, author notes, tracker data, or recalled memories.
fix: Add an explicit contextSources block to settings in assets/custom-agent.template.json with all eight keys and commented guidance, so the template teaches the opt-in model rather than inheriting the narrow default by omission. This is the highest-impact single edit remaining from the v2.4.0 sync — the template is exactly what a user would copy.

title: custom-agent template's {{message}} placeholder needs verification
reality: assets/custom-agent.template.json's promptTemplate ends with 'The message:\n{{message}}'. {{message}} does not appear in the 58 macros extracted from packages/shared/src/utils/macro-engine.ts. It may be an agent-scoped placeholder resolved outside the general macro engine, or it may be stale.
fix: Verify against the agent prompt-building path in agent-executor.ts before shipping the template edit above. If {{message}} is not resolved for custom agents, the template's core example is broken and must be corrected — do not assume either way without checking.

title: Template set has no Personal Extension starter
reality: assets/ covers character cards, custom agents, webhook tools, and lorebook entries. With Personal Extensions restored in v2.3.5 and now a first-class ideation surface (SKILL.md decision item 7, decision-guide 6b), there is no extension starter — despite the contribution descriptor being the most error-prone thing a user would hand-write, given the fixed control vocabulary and the capabilities field.
fix: Add assets/personal-extension.template.js (or .json) with a registerContribution panel skeleton, an onEvent handler writing to marinara.storage, a marinara.onCleanup call, and a capabilities block showing the explicit empty array that keeps a package in the safe runtime. Reference it from references/extensions.md.

title: Reference-file routing integrity verified
reality: All seven references/*.md paths cited in SKILL.md resolve to real files, and the references/ directory contains exactly those seven with no orphans. No broken internal routing.
